description: This file provides utility functions and a React hook to initialize and integrate the Preline library within a React application. It includes an async function to safely import and activate Preline's DOM behaviors, and a React hook to initialize Preline after component mount or dependency updates.

methods.name: initPreline()
methods.description: Asynchronously imports the 'preline' module and initializes Preline's DOM behaviors, either via a static method or by dispatching a DOMContentLoaded event.

methods.name: usePreline(deps = [])
methods.description: A React hook that triggers the initialization of Preline when the component mounts or dependencies change.
